learnerFeedback.title: What learners say about NaHo
learnerFeedback.subtitle: Real stories from learners who practice Kaiwa every day.

t1.name: Minh Anh
t1.quote: I practice 15 minutes every night, and after a month my Japanese interview reflexes improved noticeably. The pronunciation scoring is detailed down to each word.

t2.name: Quoc Bao
t2.quote: The custom question feature fits my job perfectly — I practice the exact project meeting situations I face with Japanese clients.

t3.name: Thu Ha
t3.quote: Thanks to Furigana and Vietnamese translations, a beginner like me can practice speaking confidently without fear of mistakes.

q1.question: Does NaHo help correct honorific (Keigo) mistakes?
q1.answer: Yes. The AI analyzes Keigo structures in workplace contexts, points out misuse of Sonkeigo / Kenjougo / Teineigo and suggests expressions appropriate for each situation.

q2.question: Can N5/N4 learners practice too?
q2.answer: Yes. The system supports toggling Furigana on every Kanji and instant Vietnamese translations, so beginners can still practice conversations with confidence.

q3.question: Who is this app designed for?
q3.answer: NaHo is designed for Bridge Software Engineer (BrSE) students at FPT University and Japanese learners in the tech field, especially those who need Kaiwa reflexes for interviews and Japanese workplace settings.
